correctness.rationale: The ordinary classification follows from the adjacent-endpoint parity argument in bipartite graphs and the fact that any mixed independent set in a crown has size at most two. The general-2 classification follows by requiring every selected opposite-side index to belong to each selected same-side index pair. Counting the resulting five structural cases gives the stated polynomial. Exhaustive direct shortest-path verification for n=3..9 confirms both formulas and the published-formula identification.
